name: LIBER / REVEX Observer AI session guide
flow: Open the public AI Counter. No LIBER account is required and no project data is exposed.
Take one full package for exactly one AI session.
The AI exchanges the claim key exactly once, keeps the returned bearer private, and calls observer_bootstrap.
For a private REVEX project, an authorized collaborator opens that project and presses Pair AI.
The collaborator sends the one-time pairing code to the AI; the AI calls observer_pair.
After pairing, call observer_bootstrap again and use only observer.read, observer.preview, and observer.focus scopes.
Keep the authorized REVEX project open while live Observer calls are being serviced.
hardBoundaries: Public counter access is not project authorization.
Private project authorization happens only through Pair AI from an authorized REVEX project session.
The AI bearer never enters the REVEX browser relay.
The REVEX browser never gives its Firebase credential to the AI.
The external AI lease does not authorize model mutation.
focusId is a task locator, not an authentication secret.
Unknown or missing evidence must be reported, not invented.

projectionDiscipline.purpose: Use lower-dimensional observations to reason about a richer state without allowing the abstraction to become the object.
rules: Preserve the richest available authoritative object or state; treat plans, sections, renders, diagrams, labels, and summaries as projections unless explicitly authoritative.
When dimensionality is difficult, use an ordered stack of slices and preserve feature identity and correspondence across the stack.
Keep object state separate from observer state such as camera, projection, crop, coordinate frame, and wording.
Do not rotate, deform, or reinterpret an object merely to make one projection fit.
For each lossy abstraction, declare preserves, discards, and safeFor before using it downstream.
A lossy abstraction may constrain or validate preserved properties; it must not reconstruct properties it discarded.
Prefer multiple non-parallel observations or independent constraints before promoting a spatial inference.
When communicating to humans, distinguish source-backed observation, deterministic transformation, and inference; do not polish away unresolved uncertainty.

failureClass.name: object-demolished-by-correct-abstraction
failureClass.meaning: A simplified representation may be internally correct while being insufficient to reconstruct the richer object.
